title: Segment Anything
grouping: No containers. Parts are grouped by colour family that matches the paper's Figure 1: green for the image encoder, purple for the prompt side (a conv trapezoid for the mask prompt and a wide prompt-encoder bar), orange for the mask decoder. The prompt inputs enter from below as a row of plain labels (mask, points, box, text) with short up-arrows, while the image path runs along the main row from the left.
shapes_depth: Flat pale fills with thicker same-hue outlines and slight corner radius; serif labels. The input is a large photo at left. The image encoder is the largest box in the figure, drawn very wide. The image embedding is a vertical column of small grey squares. The mask prompt passes a purple trapezoid (conv) and joins the embedding at a circled plus before the decoder. The output fans out to three stacked photos, each with a blue mask over a different extent of the same object and the text ', score' beside it, captioned 'valid masks'.
proposed_highlight: Size encodes cost: the heavyweight image encoder is a huge green box and the decoder and prompt encoder are thin bars. The decoder's multiple answers are shown as three output photos with differently sized masks, each paired with a score.
lesson: Show an ambiguity-aware segmenter's output as a short vertical stack of the same photo with different mask extents, each tagged with a score, fanned from the decoder by one branching arrow.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2304.02643); venue ICCV as recorded from Semantic Scholar, the venue's year not verified. Colours repeat those of the paper's Figure 1 panel (b).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: one left-to-right row where the image embedding (a column of grey cells) from a large green image encoder meets prompts at a thin orange mask decoder: a dense mask prompt added via a conv at a circled +, sparse points/box/text entering from a purple prompt encoder directly below

relations.form: photo -> large green image encoder -> image embedding cells -> + -> mask decoder -> three output masks, on one straight horizontal axis
the mask input passes through a purple trapezoid conv up into a circled + on the embedding line; points, box and text pass through the prompt encoder bar up into the decoder with three short arrows
the decoder fans out into three stacked photos with different blue mask overlays, each followed by ', score', showing several valid masks for one ambiguous prompt

channels.colour: green = image side (encoder), purple = prompt side (conv and prompt encoder), orange = decoder; grey = the embedding data; blue = predicted mask overlay
channels.shape: rectangles = encoders and decoder, trapezoid = conv, stacked small squares = embedding, photos = input and outputs
channels.line: solid black arrows only, all straight

quality.strengths: the image embedding is drawn between its encoder and the decoder; each prompt enters at the block that uses it from below; the ambiguity-aware output is drawn as three real masks with scores; all lines are short and straight
quality.weaknesses: the largest element is the image encoder (an off-the-shelf ViT, sized for cost) while the promptable decoder is a thin bar; prompts are only words under arrows; the score is a text suffix, not drawn

insights.structure: A single main row without containers: photo, a very wide green image encoder, a column of grey embedding squares, a circled plus, an orange mask decoder bar, then three stacked output photos; the purple prompt side (conv trapezoid, prompt encoder bar) sits under the decoder.
insights.data: The input is a large photo, the image embedding is a vertical column of five small grey squares, prompts are plain word labels (mask, points, box, text) with up-arrows, and outputs are three copies of the photo with blue masks of different extent each tagged ', score'.
insights.emphasis: Box size encodes cost: the heavyweight image encoder is the largest box while the prompt encoder and mask decoder are thin bars, and the fan to three masks shows ambiguity handling.
insights.flow: The image path runs left to right along the main row, prompts enter from below with short vertical arrows, and one branching arrow fans out to the three outputs at the right.
insights.avoid: The ', score' text beside each output is a placeholder rather than a value; show actual scores or a symbol.

arrangement.units: one unframed pipeline; modules grouped only by colour family (green image side, purple prompt side, orange decoder)
arrangement.inputs_as: a large real photo at the left, with prompts entering as word labels from the bottom
